# SafeSpace

Is my take on what the default Minecraft experience should be

It is built off of Fabulously Optimized for great performances while adding client side mods that make Minecraft more immersive and animated

I very much enjoy Actions & Stuff on bedrock and wanted a pack that can give the same sort of feel on Java, while maintaining good performance, [Hold My Items](https://modrinth.com/mod/hold-my-items) by Tree Corp is what made me want to make this pack

## Credits

This pack contains mods, resourcepacks, and shaderpacks made by other people

All of these are obtained via modrinth and are listed as dependancies under each version
